description: This file defines a mock class TimerMock template intended for unit testing. It inherits from a Timer class and utilizes Google Mock to mock its methods, enabling controlled testing of timer-related functionalities within the beerocks::net namespace.

classes.name: TimerMock
classes.description: A mock class template for Timer, used for unit testing timer functionalities with customizable time units.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the file descriptor associated with the timer.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Mocks the method to schedule the timer with a delay and period.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Mocks the method to cancel the scheduled timer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Mocks the method to read the number of timer expirations.

ctags.name: TimerMock
ctags.pattern: /^template <class TimeUnits = std::chrono::milliseconds> class TimerMock : public Timer<TimeUnits>/
